what: v5 (5 November 2026): the shot under-the-crossing again as v3's view f by day (the user: 'i prefer the composition of the original "f day" still ... re-render the video so it is like the original "f day" proposal ... during the day'), 30 s, and a separate short, waterline-reprise: the same view held with the proposed refilled level drawn as a line where the scene's surfaces cross it. Storyboard material, not frames of the film.
said_so: The plants are modelled (procedural, representative shapes), placed by v3's rule from the 28 August 2025 Sentinel-2 pass (v3/plants/plants_f.npz, unchanged); the lane toward the tower is kept open, a framing choice (v3's gap).

The towers, wires and fittings are the flight south's scene (positions OpenStreetMap's, shapes representative); the flow dashes are a drawing convention, held at the record's state of 11 September 2026 (Ferosplavna-1 connected, Dniprovska cut).
The birds are drawn: species recorded on or over the bed and at these crossings, shapes and flight representative, paths composed for the frame.
The sound is a montage (the speculative soundscape): nothing was recorded at the crossing; the line is synthesized.

The waterline is inferred x proposed: the level is a proposal (Vyshnevskyi & Shevchuk 2024, p. 286), the bed's heights it is drawn on are inferred (FABDEM's bare earth over the old reservoir is flat water: the drained bed's relief in the scene is the waterline method's, scene3d/bed.py), and the plants it crosses are modelled. It is a line, not water: no surface, fill or tint.

waterline_reprise.label: PROPOSED LEVEL · 12.7 M · VYSHNEVSKYI & SHEVCHUK 2024 · THE BED'S HEIGHTS INFERRED

level.what: the dead-volume level, proposed for a temporary dam (refilling the reservoir to it)
level.source: Vyshnevskyi & Shevchuk 2024, p. 286 (reports/ZNPP speculative ending and ecology.md)
level.note: the reports also give 12.7 m as IAEA Update 162's reservoir figure; the project config cites Update 163 for a measured level of about 12.7 m at the plant on 8 June 2023 (Update 162: 14.03 m on 7 June). Not checked again here.

datum_conversion.source: config/conductive-seam.yaml crossing3d.bed baltic_m (Baltic +0.4 m to EGM2008); the scene's z is FABDEM's metres above EGM2008

eye.note: the camera stands 2.25 m below the proposed level: at that level the view would be under water. The camera is not moved; so the level's plane lies above the eye and the line falls above the horizon, on whatever stands taller than it.

drawn_on: the caisson of tower 23: a clean line round its foot, about 0.5 m above the ground there
the reeds, tall grasses and young willows of the meadow in the distance: a broken line of dashes across their stems near the horizon (the level's plane seen from below)
the willow crown at the top left (near): patches across the leaves that lie at the level
not on tower 23 or the wires (they stand above it on the caisson), not on the sky

how.pass: still_v5.py contour: every surface drawn flat black (view_layer material override) but a band where |world z - 13.1| is under h, h = the eye distance x (36 mm / 18 mm / 1920 px) x 3.5 px x max(sin(slope), 0.15), at least 1 mm: about 7 px wide on screen; the glows left out; film-transparent; the band's red channel is the line's matte
how.composite: a saturated mid blue, sRGB (40, 110, 230), opaque, over a 1 px darker edge, sRGB (12, 34, 80) (the matte grown by 1 px), laid on the static plate, under the moving wires (they pass in front of it where nearer); plain for 2 s, faded in over 2 s (smoothstep), held. Blue at the user's request (5 November 2026: 'thicker and blue so it stands out'); a first version was white, about 2 px wide, at 0.9
